data.notes: It got the header right, including that only the international half moved and that our country analysis arrived too late, and it caught local acquiring, the CFO-average quote and the customer's 'approvals' wording. It missed that nobody had reviewed the account in 9-10 months, its message finding only says to stop the average claim without replacing it with the customer's own rates (overlapping the decider finding), and its proof finding drops speed and the named person who watches their numbers (P2/P3).
